# Silicon Oasis Residential Building

> This residential building stands in Dubai Silicon Oasis, a mixed-use technology park and housing community in the south-east of Dubai. It rises eight floors above ground, with a roof level and a health club for residents. The surrounding district combines apartment blocks with offices, schools, parks and a retail centre, and lies close to the Dubai-Al Ain road and Academic City.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Silicon Oasis, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This residential building in Dubai Silicon Oasis rises ground plus eight floors, with a roof level and a health club. It was delivered for a private owner, with Engineering Consortium as consultant. MENASCO carried out the MEP works for the building, providing the services needed for day-to-day residential occupation.
